nodes.description: Owned.owner: address of the contract administrator, set from msg.sender in constructor.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner address for two-step ownership transfer.
IFC.symbol public string token ticker ('IFC').
IFC.name public string token name ('Insurance Fintech').
IFC.decimals public uint8, set to 18.
IFC._totalSupply total minted supply (15000e18).
IFC.balances mapping(address=>uint) of token balances.
IFC.allowed nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of ERC20 allowances.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): addition guarded by require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): subtraction guarded by require(b <= a).
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): multiplication guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): division guarded by require(b > 0).
Owned constructor: sets owner = msg.sender.
Owned.transferOwnership(address): onlyOwner, stages newOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, finalises ownership.
IFC constructor: initialises metadata and mints whole supply to a fixed address.
IFC.totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
IFC.balanceOf(address): returns balances[tokenOwner].
IFC.transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves tokens from msg.sender using safeSub/safeAdd.
IFC.approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
IFC.transferFrom(from,to,tokens): debits balance and allowance of msg.sender.
IFC.allowance(address,address): returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
IFC.approveAndCall(spender,tokens,data): approves then calls external receiveApproval on spender.
IFC fallback payable: unconditionally reverts to reject ETH.
IFC.transferAnyERC20Token(tokenAddress,tokens): onlyOwner rescue that calls external ERC20 transfer.
ApproveAndCallFallBack.receiveApproval external callback entry point invoked by approveAndCall.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, balances and allowances.
Arithmetic addition a + b in safeAdd, relies on require(c >= a) to prevent overflow.
Arithmetic subtraction a - b in safeSub, relies on require(b <= a) to prevent underflow.
Arithmetic multiplication a * b in safeMul, relies on equality check to prevent overflow.
Arithmetic division a / b in safeDiv, relies on require(b > 0).
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after allowance state write; reentrancy entry point.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner,tokens) with arbitrary attacker-supplied tokenAddress.
Access control check require(msg.sender == owner) inside the onlyOwner modifier.
Access control check require(msg.sender == newOwner) inside acceptOwnership.
Plain Ether transfer handling: fallback reverts, no state change.

Parameter b of safeAdd.
Return variable c of safeAdd (result of a + b).

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner from msg.sender, establishing the privileged address from caller input.
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender to owner.
acceptOwnership compares msg.sender to newOwner before taking ownership.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], the caller-controlled account.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] keyed by the caller.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender externally.
transferAnyERC20Token is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender.
onlyOwner require(msg.sender == owner) consumes the caller address directly.
acceptOwnership require(msg.sender == newOwner) consumes the caller address directly.
safeAdd computes a + b and relies on require(c >= a) to avoid overflow.
safeSub computes a - b and relies on require(b <= a) to avoid underflow.
safeMul computes a * b and relies on the division equality check to avoid overflow.
safeDiv computes a / b and relies on require(b > 0) to avoid division by zero.
approveAndCall performs an external call to receiveApproval on the spender contract.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external transfer call on a caller-supplied token address.
The external call in approveAndCall re-enters the callee's receiveApproval implementation.
transferOwnership executes under the onlyOwner guard whose body is require(msg.sender == owner).
acceptOwnership executes require(msg.sender == newOwner) before state changes.
The payable fallback performs a bare revert, rejecting all Ether.
transfer calls safeSub on balances[msg.sender].
transfer calls safeAdd on balances[to].
transferFrom calls safeSub on balances[from] and on the allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd on balances[to].
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
transfer writes the balances mapping for sender and receiver.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom writes the allowed mapping for the spender.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
transferOwnership writes the pending newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
Parameter a flows into the safeAdd addition.
Parameter b flows into the safeAdd addition.
Return variable c is produced by safeAdd.
Parameter _newOwner flows into the newOwner state variable.
Parameter to flows into the credited balances entry.
Parameter tokens flows into safeSub/safeAdd in transfer.
Parameter spender flows into the allowed mapping key.
Parameter tokens flows into the allowance value in approve.
Parameter from flows into the debited balances entry.
Parameter to flows into the credited balances entry in transferFrom.
Parameter tokens flows into safeSub/safeAdd in transferFrom.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
Parameter spender indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
Parameter spender is both the allowance key and the external callee contract.
Parameter tokens flows into the allowance and the external call arguments.
Parameter data is attacker-controlled calldata forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
Parameter tokenAddress selects the contract targeted by the external transfer call.
Parameter tokens is forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer call.
Callback parameter from is supplied by the calling IFC contract.
Callback parameter tokens is supplied by the calling IFC contract.
Callback parameter token is supplied by the calling IFC contract.
Callback parameter data carries attacker-controlled payload into receiveApproval.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter a is only used inside safeAdd, so it can be normalised into the function's arithmetic summary.
Parameter b is only used inside safeAdd, so it can be normalised into the function's arithmetic summary.
Return variable c is defined entirely by safeAdd and adds no independent semantic value.
_newOwner is written directly to the newOwner state variable inside transferOwnership.
Parameter to only indexes the credited balances entry within transfer.
Parameter tokens is only consumed by the safeSub/safeAdd calls inside transfer.
Parameter spender is only an allowance mapping key inside approve.
Parameter tokens is only the allowance value written by approve.
Parameter from only indexes the debited balances and allowance entries in transferFrom.
Parameter to only indexes the credited balances entry in transferFrom.
Parameter tokens only feeds the safeSub/safeAdd calls in transferFrom.
tokenOwner is only a read index into the balances mapping in balanceOf.
tokenOwner is only a first-level index into the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender is only a second-level index into the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender is both the allowance key and the external callee, directly enabling the reentrancy entry point.
tokens is only written as the allowance value and echoed to the external call.
data is untrusted calldata forwarded verbatim to the external receiveApproval call.
tokenAddress is the attacker-influenced target of the external ERC20 transfer call.
tokens is the amount argument passed to the external ERC20 transfer call.
from is only used as an identifier inside the callback implementation.
tokens is only an amount argument inside the callback implementation.
token is only an address argument inside the callback implementation.
data is only a payload argument inside the callback implementation.
